articles.headline: Fast-food chain Greggs benches Mexican sandwich ahead on England World Cup match
articles.description: English fast food chain Greggs has stopped selling their Mexican sandwich range for the duration of July 5 due to England's World Cup round-of-16 clash with Mexico, they have announced on Instagram.
